title: Backup and restore dialogs fit a 360 px viewport
steps: S1: Common setup (tests/regression/README.md § Common setup): O, seat A's cookie, api, the CDP browser; never close pages or contexts.

S2: Pick S = a site A owns (scv2 stand: qa1wp01.scv2.tracy.test); run api a POST /api/sites/<S>/backup '{"title":"REG-005-point","notes":""}' and record N = body.version (expect database.state 'full').

S3: Create browser.newContext({viewport:{width:360,height:800}, colorScheme:'dark', locale:'vi-VN'}) with A's cookie; open Site changes for S (goto O/<S>; wait URL '/s/session-' and "[contenteditable='true']"; goto with tab=tracy:changes&site=<S>; wait '.tv-activity-v2' and until '.tv-activity-v2 [data-reading]' is absent); wait for "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>']".

S4: Define measure(): page.evaluate returning {vw: documentElement.clientWidth, sw: documentElement.scrollWidth, boxSizing: getComputedStyle(d).boxSizing, offsetWidth: d.offsetWidth, dialog: rect(d), close: rect(d.querySelector("[data-slot='dialog-close']")), controls: rects of d.querySelectorAll("input, textarea, [data-slot='dialog-footer'] button")} where d = document.querySelector("[role=dialog][data-slot='dialog-content'].tracy-site-tabs") and rect = {left, right} of getBoundingClientRect().

S5: Click '[data-create-backup]'; wait for '[role=dialog] [data-draft]'; wait 600 ms (open animation); record measure() as create; screenshot; press Escape and wait until no "[role=dialog][data-slot='dialog-content']" remains.

S6: Click "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>'] button.tv-activity-event-main" until aria-expanded is 'true'; click "li.tv-backup[data-backup='<N>'] [data-detail] [data-restore='backup']" (Restore…; Everything is chosen first); wait for '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]'; wait 600 ms; record measure() as everything (controls include the two scope radios, [data-confirm-word] and [data-confirm-everything]); screenshot. Then record WORD = [the trimmed text of the label for '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]', its placeholder, document.activeElement's trimmed text, '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-everything]'.disabled]; fill '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]' with 'restore' and record OPEN = '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-everything]'.disabled (never click it).

S7: In the same dialog click '[role=dialog] [data-scope-option="files"] input'; wait until '[role=dialog] [data-confirm-word]' is gone; wait 600 ms; record measure() as files; press Escape without confirming.
expect: Each recorded dialog (create, everything, files): vw == 360 and sw == 360 (no sideways scroll).
Each: boxSizing == 'border-box' (pre-fix: 'content-box' on the dialog root).
Each: offsetWidth ≤ 328 (stand after fix: 328 = 360 − 2rem; pre-fix: 394 with left −17).
Each: dialog.left ≥ 15 and dialog.right ≤ 345 (tracy-ui 1rem gutter kept).
Each: close.left ≥ 0 and close.right ≤ 345 (after fix: 307..335; pre-fix: 340..368).
Each: every control left ≥ 16 and right ≤ 344 (after fix: 33..327; pre-fix: 0..360).

WORD deep-equals ['Gõ “Restore” để xác nhận', 'Restore', 'Huỷ', true] (vi-VN: the instruction is translated, the word is English; Cancel holds the focus; was the site address); OPEN === false (any case).
evidence: tasks/evidence/site-changes-v2/qa/r1/bugs/QA-I15.md (fix dba4b5960); the QA note is Studio-local (not in git), the fix commit is on develop
fence: packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/src/client/site-tabs.css puts box-sizing:border-box on the .tracy-site-tabs root a dialog popup carries, and every site-tabs DialogContent uses sm:max-w-md so tracy-ui's max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] gutter survives below 640 px.
